text:
jess: Heads-up: Acme demo at 10am PST tomorrow. Need a hosted API key for the POC that auto-expires after 48h, IP allowlist for their office, and a revocation link we can hand them. Also need a short rotation plan in case they ask for an extension — can we get this done today?
omar: On it. Do we want ephemeral token (recommended) or a short-lived permanent token? Ephemeral is safer — no manual revocation if TTL is acceptable.
jess: They explicitly asked for the ability to revoke instantly. So ephemeral + a revocation URL would be ideal. 48h TTL is fine. IPs: 198.51.100.12, 198.51.100.13. Add 203.0.113.5 for our tunnel.
lina: We can create an ephemeral key via the token service. Command below — will create token scoped to project=acme-demo and restrict to IP allowlist. I will run this after final approval.
```bash
redwoodctl tokens create \
  --project=acme-demo \
  --scopes="generate:responses,embeddings:read" \
  --ttl=48h \
  --allowlist=198.51.100.12,198.51.100.13,203.0.113.5
```
Token prints once — store in secret manager or paste into secure note in SF.
ryan-sec: Quick sec note: for POCs we require no admin:* scopes on hosted POC keys and audit logging enabled. Set token label to 'acme-demo-sales' and enable SIEM forwarding.
omar: Agreed. Lina — can you also ensure the token metadata includes a one-click revoke flag (redwoodctl tokens revoke <id>) and a human-friendly revocation URL?
lina: Yes — revoke endpoint is /v1/tokens/{id}/revoke. I'll include that in the ticket and set the metadata fields (label, owner, project). Also recommend adding a rotation_hook to optionally send a webhook to our ops channel if they request extension.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: creating token for project=acme-demo... pending approval by @jess
jess: Approved — go ahead.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: token created: token_demo_******** (expires in 48h). ID=tok_2087654321_acme. revocation_url: https://console.redwood.ai/tokens/tok_2087654321_acme/revoke
jess: Great — I'll deliver the token via secure note in SF and include revocation instructions + the IP allowlist. Omar — can you add a TTL cleanup note in the POC runbook so we don't get surprised if they ask for an extension?
omar: Will do. Also documenting rotation steps: if they need >48h, create a new ephemeral token with requested TTL, update the ticket, then revoke the old token.
ryan-sec: :thumbsup: Also tracked in security tracker ST-POC-512. Ensure logs are forwarded to our SIEM and link to token_id in the ticket.
lina: Done — logs forwarded, added token_id to the ticket, and attached the redwoodctl output.
